findings.body: The recorded DUB-only live walk says the returned set matched the 13 statement leaves plus unmapped-GL, but it does not verify the required precondition that every July budget is zero or positive. That check is necessary for the `% > 100`/`over-budget` screen rows to be a valid oracle for `Actual > Budget`: with a negative budget, a row can satisfy the comparison without appearing in that screen-derived set. Record the budget-sign assertion against the live July data as part of row 5.

findings.body: The fallback converts both endpoints of every applied window to month/year labels. For example, a `posting_date` window from `2026-07-10` to `2026-07-20` with no `periodControl` becomes just `July 2026`, so both the readout and empty-state message claim a broader period than was queried. New evidence beyond the coordinator ruling is this fallback path: only a same-month window on the `month` column should collapse to a month label; other windows must retain their exact date wording. Preserve the raw/custom range for non-month columns and add a leaf for it.
findings.title: Preserve exact non-month periods when periodControl is absent
